subject: Technical audit kickoff: CAIQ scope alignment & log access timetable
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah O'Neill <sarah.oneill@skylinehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-19T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Technical audit kickoff: CAIQ scope alignment & log access timetable

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for taking time to run through the intake materials last week. To keep momentum, suggested agenda and asks for the kickoff: 

- 15m: Introductions + scope (CAIQ lanes we're targeting)
- 20m: Logging & retention requirements — what Skyline needs to see (sample types, retention windows)
- 15m: Artifact handoff & timelines (who owns what; dry-run window)
- 10m: Next steps and alignment on dates for sample delivery

Proposed times: Tue 5/25 10:00–10:45 PT or Wed 5/26 14:00–14:45 PT. If neither work, send 1–2 alternatives and we’ll accommodate.

Attached is a short CAIQ scope map (redwood_caiq_scope_map.xlsx) that maps our artifacts to the SIG/CAIQ sections you flagged in the intake.

Quick asks before the call: 
- Confirm whether you need redacted or raw logs for the initial validation (we can do both but want to know preferred format).
- Point of contact for procurement/contract – I have procurement@skylinehealth.com copied if you want to loop them in.

I can lead the kickoff; Marissa will own the evidence handoff (naming, upload portal), Kimberly will own the log samples and runbook for exports.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Jonas Weber
Security Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood_caiq_scope_map.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Sarah O'Neill <sarah.oneill@skylinehealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, procurement@skylinehealth.com
Date: 2027-05-19T10:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Technical audit kickoff: CAIQ scope alignment & log access timetable

Jonas —

Appreciate the clear agenda and the scope map. Either 5/25 10a PT or 5/26 2p PT works for our core team; leaning to 5/25 to keep this week moving.

A couple of clarifications before we block time: 
- For initial validation, we prefer redacted logs with consistent timestamps and the fields listed in our intake form (ip.address, user.id, request.path, response.code, actor.role). If you can provide a sample in both JSONL and compressed text that would be ideal.
- Our legal team requests a short excerpt of your SOC 2 attestation cover page (pdf) for procurement before we sign any data transfer docs. Can you attach that or point to where we can download it?
- For retention: our reviewers typically want 90-day hot-window samples and a six-month archive snapshot. Is that feasible?

If you can confirm those items and send updated calendar invite for Tue 5/25 10:00 PT, I'll route to procurement and our CISO's office.

Thanks,
Sarah O'Neill
Director, IT Risk & Compliance
Skyline Health
[sarah.oneill@skylinehealth.com]

On Wed, May 19, 2027 at 9:02 AM Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Sarah —
> 
> Thanks again for taking time to run through the intake materials last week...

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah O'Neill <sarah.oneill@skylinehealth.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-19T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Technical audit kickoff: CAIQ scope alignment & log access timetable

Sarah / team —

Thanks for the quick reply and the specifics — that's helpful. Confirming a few operational details so the kickoff is productive: 

- Redacted JSONL + gzipped text samples: yes, we can provide both. We'll prepare a 24-hour sample slice that includes the fields you listed and a separate 90-day aggregated snapshot for the retention reviewers.
- SOC 2 attestation excerpt: attached is the cover page and auditor summary (redwood-soc2-excerpt.pdf). If procurement needs the full report we can coordinate an NDA channel for delivery.
- Retention feasibility: 90-day hot window + six-month snapshot is supported for hosted customers; we'll include a note about export formats and the timeframe for retrieval (typically 48–72 hours for archive pulls).

Operational owners: 
- Evidence upload: me (Marissa) — we'll share a secure SharePoint/Drive folder link during the call and follow up with instructions.
- Log exports & runbook: Kimberly will produce the log_sample_instructions and a small runbook for safe redaction.

I've created a placeholder HubSpot deal for tracking: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/98765 and added the procurement contact you cc'd. I'll send a calendar invite for Tue 5/25 10:00 PT and include a short prep packet.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-excerpt.pdf (pdf)

—
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Security Onboarding
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah O'Neill <sarah.oneill@skylinehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, procurement@skylinehealth.com
Date: 2027-05-20T14:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Technical audit kickoff: CAIQ scope alignment & log access timetable

Sarah —

Thanks — calendar invite for Tue 5/25 10:00 PT sent (30–45 min block + prep packet). Quick confirmations and next steps before the call: 

- We've attached the log sample export instructions (redwood_log_sample_instructions.pdf) with recommended redaction steps and a checklist for the 24-hour slice. Kimberly will run a dry export later this week and share the artifact.
- SOC 2 excerpt is attached in Marissa's note; if procurement needs the full report, we'll provision via secure portal under NDA.
- Data residency: Redwood hosts Skyline's environment in the us-west region by default; if you require EU-only residency we can outline a private deployment path, but that will affect export timelines.

Action items: 
1) Marissa — share secure folder link and upload checklist before EOD 5/21.
2) Kimberly — run dry export and confirm format (JSONL + gz) by 5/22.
3) Sarah/procurement — confirm whether redacted sample is acceptable or if you need raw samples (procurement request noted).

See you on Tue. If anything else comes up before then, drop a reply and we'll triage.

Jonas Weber
Security Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood_log_sample_instructions.pdf (application/pdf)]
